pages.text:
File 4
Listening 1
Sandra
What do you do, Adam?
Adam
Oh, I’m a barman.
Sandra
A barman?
Adam
Yeah. I work in a bar in the city centre. It’s a wine bar but
we make Mexican food, too.
Sandra
Do you like your job?
Adam
Sure.
Sandra
What do you like about it?
Adam
Well, I don’t get up early. My wife gets up at six in the
morning but I get up at ten. And the bar is near my
home. I walk to work every day and that’s very nice. I
don’t have a car, you see. And I meet a lot of people.
Sandra
Do you work long hours?
Adam
Well, yes. I don’t go to bed before 12. It’s usually one in
the morning or two at weekends before I go to bed. And I
always work on Saturday and sometimes on Sundays.
But I never work on Mondays. Mondays are fantastic. It’s
my favourite day of the week.
File 4
Listening 2
1
Curator
I’m sorry, sir, but you can’t use your mobile phone in
the museum.
Joe
Oh. Sorry … er … where can I use it?
Curator
Well, you can go outside, sir. Or you can use it in the
coffee shop.
Joe
The coffee shop?
Curator
Yes, sir. It’s …
2
Jim
What time do you finish work, Vicky?
Vicky
Oh, well, I work late on Fridays and I sometimes finish
at seven or eight. But from Monday to Thursday I
always finish at six.
Jim
OK. Well, do you want to …
3
Jake
What sports do people do in the winter in your country,
Elena?
Elena
Well, it’s very cold here. We can ski in the mountains, of
course. But we can’t swim in the sea in the winter! A lot
of people like football but we don’t play tennis or golf
outside.
4
Mike
Can I have a coffee and a sandwich, please?
Dawn
Sure. Here you are.
Mike
Thank you. How much is that?
Dawn
Er … the coffee is one pound twenty and the sandwich
is two pounds sixty. So that’s three pounds eighty.
Mike
OK. Thank you.
5
Kate
Hi, mum.
Mum
Oh hi, Kate. Are you tired?
Kate
No, I’m hot. I want a nice cold drink of water.
Mum
Sit down and I'll get you one. Do you want a sandwich,
too?
Kate
No, thanks.
